# Tizora
> AI product engineering, computer vision, and cloud architecture for enterprise businesses. Tizora designs and builds AI-ready software for healthcare, aviation, fintech, parking and eCommerce teams, with delivery teams across India, the UK and the USA.

## Case Studies
- [All case studies](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/case-studies): Every Tizora case study, filterable by industry.
- [Aircraft Turnaround Management Software](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/case-studies/aviation/aircraft-turnaround-management-software): How Tizora's turnaround management software flagged delay risk 18 minutes earlier and lifted on-time departures 7 points in an airport pilot.
- [Digital KYC — Paperless customer onboarding](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/case-studies/fintech/digital-kyc): How Tizora helped a regional Indian bank cut account opening from 3 days to under 5 minutes with V-CIP video KYC, OCR and Aadhaar eSign.
- [Mobile Banking Platform](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/case-studies/fintech/mobile-banking): Mobile banking platform case study: how Tizora connected a secure, API-first app to core banking and moved 60% of routine transactions off branch counters.
- [Core Banking Operations Platform](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/case-studies/fintech/core-banking): Core banking platform case study: Tizora unified deposits, lending, accounting, branch and member operations on one auditable, API-ready foundation for banks.
- [AI-Enhanced LPR Parking Enforcement](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/case-studies/parking/ai-lpr-parking-enforcement): AI license plate recognition case study: how Tizora made a mobile parking enforcement app read plates in snow, mud, glare and blur, with fewer repeated scans.
- [Digital Weight Management Platform](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/case-studies/healthcare/weight-management): Digital weight management platform case study: Bluetooth scale sync, one view of weight, sleep and exercise data, and video care for gastric balloon patients.
- [AI-Ready Patient Management](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/case-studies/healthcare/ai-ready-patient-management-platform): Connected medication management: one patient record for medication, pharmacy and barcode inventory on AWS, helping nurses spend less time on administration and more on patient care.
- [CStore Master: eCommerce & AMR Robotics](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/case-studies/retail/cstore-master): How CStore Master connected Magento, Shopify and mobile ordering apps to AMR warehouse robots: 60% faster fulfillment and 40% lower labor cost.
- [AI Skin Analysis for Skincare E-Commerce](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/case-studies/retail/ai-skin-analysis): AI skin analysis case study: a selfie-based face scan that detects visible skin concerns and maps each one to in-stock products in a skincare brand's catalog.

- [Seeing Turnaround Delays Before They Happen](https://www.tizora.ai/insights/ebooks/aircraft-turnaround-delay-guide): A practical guide to aircraft turnaround management for airport operations teams (PDF: https://www.tizora.ai/ebooks/aircraft-turnaround-delay-guide.pdf).

## Industries
- [Industries](https://www.tizora.ai/industries): The industries Tizora builds for, with case studies for each.
- [Healthcare Software Development](https://www.tizora.ai/industries/healthcare): Healthcare software development company building HIPAA-aligned, FHIR-ready patient management and medication platforms that are ready for AI.
- [Aviation](https://www.tizora.ai/industries/aviation): AI intelligence for airport operations: turnaround, gate and stand, and flight-disruption decisions built on operational data, SOPs and real-time events.
- [Fintech](https://www.tizora.ai/industries/fintech): Software for banks and financial institutions: core banking, mobile banking and digital KYC onboarding.
- [AI License Plate Recognition for Parking Enforcement](https://www.tizora.ai/industries/parking): Tizora builds AI license plate recognition for parking enforcement: an AI layer on your existing LPR engine that reads plates in snow, mud and glare.
- [eCommerce](https://www.tizora.ai/industries/ecommerce): eCommerce platforms, headless commerce and warehouse robotics integration, and AI-driven product discovery.

## Services
- [AI Product Engineering for Startups (MVP)](https://www.tizora.ai/services/startup-mvp): Custom MVP development, rapid prototyping and agile delivery for fast market validation.
- [Product Engineering for Mid-Market Businesses](https://www.tizora.ai/services/mid-market): Scalable product engineering to modernize operations and digital products for growing companies.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://www.tizora.ai/services/enterprise-solutions): Rapid prototyping, secure cloud architecture and market-ready engineering for large organizations.
- [Shopify Plus Partner](https://www.tizora.ai/shopify-plus-partner): Headless Shopify Plus architectures, custom checkout flows and migrations.

## Security & Compliance
- [AI Security](https://www.tizora.ai/cybersecurity/ai-security): Securing LLM applications, RAG pipelines and autonomous agents against prompt injection, data leakage and model-layer attacks.
- [Application Security](https://www.tizora.ai/cybersecurity/application-security): Threat modeling, secure code review, SAST/DAST, dependency scanning and penetration testing built into the SDLC.
- [Shopify App VAPT](https://www.tizora.ai/cybersecurity/vapt-shopify-apps): Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing for Shopify apps.
- [DPDP Act Compliance](https://www.tizora.ai/compliance/dpdp): Consent architecture, Data Principal rights and breach response for India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
- [VPAT & Accessibility](https://www.tizora.ai/compliance/vpat-accessibility): WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA audits, remediation and VPAT / Accessibility Conformance Report documentation.
- [Shopify App VPAT](https://www.tizora.ai/compliance/vpat-shopify-apps): Accessibility conformance documentation for Shopify apps.
